title: Threads Teach
summary: Learn to write for Threads in short lessons on your own posts, with a private learning workspace and one self-written post per lesson, saved or scheduled only after exact approval.
triggers: teach me how to write Threads posts

outputs.name: lesson, learning record and one learner-written post

free_capabilities: private mission, lesson and learning-record workspace
coaching on pasted posts without a connection
paid_capability_stubs: connected reads of the learner's own posts and results depend on current Threadify scopes and plan entitlement
the deeper Threads system beyond the core lessons

must_show: local date and time when scheduling

instructions: Teach on posts the learner pastes and call them a sample, never their best posts.
Say plainly which results, rankings and numbers cannot be seen or checked.
Hand the finished post to the learner to schedule themselves and record it as handed over, not saved or scheduled.
